NOT JOINED, and why:
807:8322/8325/8328/8331/8334 the chip BOXES — every one carries an
explicit width (58, 108, 104, 117, 93) that is its own label plus the
range text. Label-driven, i.e. sample data; the live cells are w-8 glyphs

alone would make it 44. Shrinking the whole toolbar to a 24 content row is
a change to a control this board shares with the toolbar's own family, and
no recipe measures that yet. Recorded, not taken.
NOT BUILT — and this is the board's namesake. 807:8321 is a 32-high
--flowbite/gray/50 STRIP across the top of the canvas (760 wide on the
board) holding FIVE chips that each name their range on screen:
Base      'All'          ink-placeholder 10px
Desktop   '>=992px'      white-ish #D9E5FF 10px, chip filled accent
Tablet    '768-991px'
Mobile L  '480-767px'
plus a 120x20 viewport-width-indicator (807:8339). The product has none of

BreakpointSwitcher's `widthHint` already computes them and already cites

comment refuses the board's 992/480 for exactly that reason);

`check-design-debt-ratchet`'s offscale-font-size rule is locked at
zero — the same wall the pages-command-palette and smart-guides
recipes hit.
Founder call. If the bar is wanted, the breakpoint SET moves first.
